name: Shen Jinhua
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2025); Hurun China (2010-2026); Hurun Global (2026)
forbes_bio: Shen Jinhua chairs Focus Technology, the parent company of InQbrands, which operates two of China's popular business-to-business e-commerce sites: Made-in-China.com, Abiz.com, xyz.cn and InQbrands.

Launched in 1998, Made-in-China.com connects 12 million buyers to suppliers who hail from 220 countries and regions and cover a slew of categories ranging from food and chemicals to medicine and transportation.
In 2015 Focus Technology acquired U.S.-based Doba Inc., a similar platform that connects buyers and suppliers.

name: David Tran
appears_on: Forbes real-time (former) (2024); Forbes annual (2023); Hurun Global (2024)
forbes_bio: David Tran is the founder and owner of Huy Fong Foods, the Irwindale, California-based company that makes Sriracha hot sauce.
Tran arrived in the U.S. as a refugee from Vietnam in 1979 and started selling hot sauce from a blue Chevy van in Los Angeles in February 1980.
He first started making chili sauce as a cook in the South Vietnamese Army in the 1970s and later made his own sauce after the end of the Vietnam War.
Sriracha is now the third-largest hot sauce brand in the U.S., behind Tabasco and Frank's RedHot, according to market research firm IBISWorld.
Tran's two children, William and Yassie, both work at the company and are in line to inherit the business.
forbes_facts: The ingredients of Sriracha have stayed the same since the beginning--chili, sugar, salt, garlic and vinegar?and the company has never advertised its products.
Sriracha's bottles with a rooster logo and green cap have been seen everywhere from the TV show Survivor to the International Space Station.

name: Zhou Jian
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2001-2025); Hurun Global (2017-2026); Hurun China (2017-2026); Hurun Unicorn founders (2019-2023)
forbes_bio: Zhou Jian is the founder and CEO of artificial intelligence and robotics firm UBTECH Robotics.
UBTECH Robotics investors include Tencent, one of China's largest Internet companies.
UBTECH listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange in December 2023.

name: Shivratan Taparia
appears_on: Forbes real-time (former) (2025); Forbes annual (2024); Hurun Global (2024-2025); Hurun India (2018-2019)
forbes_bio: Plastics tycoon Shivratan Taparia gets his wealth from a stake in BSE-listed flagship Supreme Industries.
Taparia has a board seat at Supreme Industries.
Supreme is one of India's largest plastic processors, making everything from moulded furniture to composite gas cylinders.
The Mumbai-headquartered company also makes bathroom fittings and storage products in its 28 factories across India.
Taparia also has a small stake in Supreme Petrochem, which produces polystyrene, used for construction and packaging.
forbes_facts: His uncles Bajranglal Taparia and  Mahaveer Prasad Taparia also have valuable stakes in the Supreme group of companies.

name: Guilherme Peirao Leal
appears_on: Forbes real-time (former) (2024); Forbes annual (2006-2021); Hurun Global (2014-2026)
forbes_bio: The bulk of Guilherme Peirao Leal's fortune comes from his stake in the cosmetics company Natura &Co.
A Brazilian company similar to Avon, Natura has a network of over 8 million consultants worldwide.
These consultants sell Natura products door-to-door across Brazil, six other Latin American countries and France.
Natura, which went public in 2004, bought bought UK Cosmetics chain The Body Shop from L'Oréal in 2017 for over $1 billion.
Peirao Leal joined in 1979 and now co-chairs Natura with its founder and fellow billionaire Antonio Luiz Seabra.
forbes_facts: He is a returnee to this year's Billionaires list after dropping off in 2015.

name: Anthony Hsieh
sec_insider_companies: loanDepot, Inc. (LDI) - Executive Chair, CEO & Pres.
appears_on: Forbes real-time (former) (2021); Forbes annual (2021); SEC insider holdings (2026)
forbes_bio: Anthony Hsieh is the founder and CEO of California-based mortgage lender loanDepot.
He founded loanDepot in 2010 and took it public in February 2021; he owns 54% of the company, which has a 2% float on the New York Stock Exchange.
Before starting loanDepot, he founded HomeLoanCenter.com in 2002, an online lender that merged with online marketplace LendingTree in 2004.
His first foray in the mortgage business was in 1989, when he acquired a mortgage brokerage he renamed LoansDirect.com; he sold it to E-Trade in 2001.
Hsieh is a first-generation American born in Taiwan who emigrated to the U.S. with his family as a young child.
forbes_facts: In 2018 he founded War Heroes on Water, an annual sport fishing competition for U.S. veterans wounded in combat that raises funds for therapeutic services.
